lines: The Drone Dogs were approaching, while firing their machine guns.
Behind them, the cyborgs with machine gun shoulders were also starting to fire all at once.
They would let the drones do the close-quarters fighting, they themselves would attack from afar, and then they would finish their opponents off with suitcase cannons at the end.
The bullets that were sprayed from a distance all flew in wrong directions due to a barrier of wind that Asuka had created in advance.
「I'd obviously at least be prepared to engage the enemy, wouldn't I?!」
Asuka promptly utilized her next Ninja Art.
Riding on the wind, she flew high up above.
There were no enemies with flight capability.
Even without having her combat limbs on, an open space like a runway was the ideal spot for Wind Escape Arts.
Not to mention, from the sky, she was free to go all-out.
「Take this! Wind God: Slashing Wind Barrage!」
A whirlwind broke out on the runway, that would undoubtedly have prevented a plane from landing if one were in the sky.
The air was stirred around at ultrahigh speed, and the countless vacuum blades created by that engulfed all the cyborgs at once.
Anything flesh and blood would be torn to pieces in the blink of an eye.
Even their tough cyborg bodies were being cut to shreds by the vacuum.
They hadn't been wiped out with one attack, but they had been dealt wounds all over their bodies, and their movements had noticeably dulled.
She asked Lena, who was below her, to finish them off, but
「Waaah, don't come! Don't come over heeere!!」
Before she knew it, Lena was surrounded by Drone Dogs, and was darting around in a panic for some reason.
She was like a different person from before.
She was running around screaming, and swinging her sword like an amateur.
「A dog is a dog!! Hyaaahh!! B-Blossom Step!」
Lena was hopping around frantically like fluttering cherry blossom petals, dodging the Drone Dogs' shooting and biting entirely.
She didn't look at all like a Hell Knight, though.
「What is with that girl? She's not a gluttonous freeloading monster out of some manga.」(TL: A reference to the titular character of Obake no Q-Tarou, who has a major fear of dogs.)
Even if Asuka tried to help, if she attacked from here, Lena would get caught up in it along with them.
She descended for the moment, and was about to use an appropriate Art, when
The heads of the Drone Dogs that were chasing Lena around were sent flying clean off.
「I apologize for before. The root of all evil here is those people, right?!」
「As an apology for misunderstanding, Kuroda Tomoe will back you up!」
Tomoe pointed her sword sternly at the remaining cyborgs.
「Suddenly attacking us, then backing us up out of nowhere... What's with this girl, too?」
Asuka didn't get it, but gaining allies was a good thing.
The surviving cyborgs were taking flight with jerky steps, as though they had already realized their defeat.
Asuka, who had been about to chase after them, realized that a strange-looking giant was approaching from behind the fleeing cyborgs.
His figure, which was clad in Japanese armour, and carried an enormous metal club, didn't seem realistic in the slightest.
「“...Reveals the truth that, in time, all who flourish shall fall!!”」(TL: A famous quote from the Heike Monogatari.)
The giant had begun to bring down his metal bat on the cyborgs and destroy them one after another.
「Wr-Wrong. What on earth is that ominous evil aura?」
「I have a really bad feeling about this.」
「Fu fu fu. At last all obstacles are gone.」
A sinister face filled with murderous intent smiled at them.
The weirdest person today calmly approached.
